system_category.reference: CLIP jointly trains an image encoder and a text encoder to predict the correct pairings of a batch of (image, text) training examples.
system_category.matched_span: CLIP jointly trains an image encoder and a text encoder to predict the correct pairings of a batch of (image, text) training examples.

retrieval_mechanism.reference: CLIP learns a multi-modal embedding space by jointly training an image encoder and text encoder to maximize the cosine similarity of the image and text embeddings of the N real pairs in the batch while minimizing the cosine similarity of the embeddings of the N 2 -N incorrect pairings.

supported_modality.reference: We study the performance of this approach by benchmarking on over 30 different existing computer vision datasets, spanning tasks such as OCR, action recognition in videos, geo-localization, and many types of fine-grained object classification.
